building_identity: Franklin Levering Cary Quadrangle (South), Purdue abbreviation CQS; GIS feature FID 653

sources.role: authoritative building footprint, identity, address and level attributes
sources.feature_id: FID=653; BLDG_ABBR=CQS; BUILDING_N=Franklin Levering Cary Quadrangle (South); address=1016 W Stadium Avenue
sources.measurement_method: Project each polygon vertex with the Purdue project local approximation X=(lon+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(40.4274°), Y=(lat-40.4274)*111040; simplify small boundary traces at 0.22 m tolerance. The GIS polygon controls plan shape and campus location.
sources.uncertainty: Extrution units are undocumented. The feature is used for XY shape/location only. NUM_LEVELS is recorded as an attribute, not interpreted as seven above-grade storeys.

sources.measurement_method: Visual roof-plan context and U-shaped courtyard confirmation; no dimensions measured from pixels.
sources.uncertainty: Orthophoto resolution and export resampling preclude deriving facade, floors or height.

sources.role: building-specific south elevation and distinctive facade details
sources.provider: Wikimedia Commons image by Tstuddud; original photographer metadata credits Tstuddud
sources.source_date: 2006-09-17 19:03 UTC (image metadata); Commons page says south building looking north
sources.source_crs: WGS84 coordinates for camera point; image pixels have no geometric CRS
sources.measurement_method: Visual form reference for red brick, pale stone piers, paired crenellated towers, central projecting bay/arched entry, and horizontal facade rhythm. Dimensions are not measured from this perspective image.
sources.rights: Public domain statement on the Commons file page.
sources.uncertainty: One 2006 photo; perspective/landscaping obscures some details and does not establish exact dimensions or roof pitch.

sources.role: South wing renovation and use context
sources.measurement_method: Identity-specific renovation history and broad program context only; page project photos are interior images and are not used as exterior evidence.
sources.uncertainty: 140,000 sq ft describes rehabilitated project area, not a footprint measurement.

sources.role: Purdue historical identity and construction context
sources.provider: Purdue Campus Facilities and Buildings Historic Database
sources.source_date: Record covers 1939-present and states South was the fifth/final Cary building
sources.measurement_method: Identity, construction and broad historic context only.
sources.uncertainty: Historic database reports 173,256 gross sq ft, not a measured footprint or height.

sources.measurement_method: Confirms South preserves its original layout while the four outer buildings were renovated. Not used for dimensions.
sources.uncertainty: No South-specific exterior dimensions or elevations.
